**Exploring 9/11 films**

I think the user is asking about movies related to 9/11. Maybe the movie "World Trade Center" comes to mind, as it deals with the event and its aftermath, but it’s undeniably sad and tragic. There's also the film "United 93," which focuses on one of the flights. I consider "The Towering Inferno" too, though it's about a fictional fire in a high-rise. It seems I’ll need to clarify which film might be linked to their query!
